name: basalt-frontend
description: Basalt SPA sources. Bundled into app.js by ../build-js.sh (esbuild); pure modules are tested with node --test.

scripts.build: npx --yes esbuild@0.24.2 src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --sourcemap --legal-comments=none --banner:js='/* GENERATED FILE - edit web/frontend/src/ and run ./build-js.sh */' --outfile=app.js
